name: Teen Science Scholars
org: Denver Museum of Nature and Science
what_you_do: Spend three weeks in a summer internship with museum scientists on a research track. Some tracks include outdoor fieldwork. Lunch vouchers and materials are covered.
who_can_apply: Sophomores or juniors (the page ties this to the 2025-2026 school year). Ages 14 to 17 during the internship. You must be free Monday to Friday for a full session. It is for high schoolers from underserved or underrepresented communities or schools.
pay_detail: $1,803 per session in 2026. The page says it is to cover expenses, not wages.
duration: Three weeks. 2026 sessions: early June to late June, or early July to early August.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed and the page gives no 2027 dates. For 2026, interviews were expected in late March and early April, with offers in mid April.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it opens. Pick your top two tracks and a session, and give your household income and size. No transcript or recommendation is needed.
notes: The museum site blocked our regular reader, so this was read through a page summary tool. Out of state students can apply if they are at the museum for the whole program. Housing is not provided. RTD buses are free for riders 19 and younger. Phone 303-370-6478.
